cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial screen renders all captions, the Auth ID entry field and the function-key legend
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; operator signed on; transaction ORPI started fresh from the main menu.
cases.steps:
1. From the main menu, start the Pending Authorization Inquiry (transaction ORPI)
2. Observe the initial screen before typing anything
cases.expected: The header shows Tran "ORPI", Pgm "OCPAUIN", the title "ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM" and the current date and time. The Auth ID entry field is shown empty at the cursor; the result captions Card Num, Acct ID, Amount, Merchant, Req TS, Status and Decision are present with empty values; the bottom line shows the legend "ENTER=Inquire PF3=Back PF4=Clear PF8=Next".
cases.remark: map MPAUINA (mapset MPAUIN); 1000-SEND-INITIAL / 8000-POPULATE-HEADER; WHEAD WS-HDR-TITLE; legend literal at map line 24

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: On open the guidance message is shown and the result fields are blank
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; transaction ORPI just opened on the key prompt.
cases.steps:
1. Start transaction ORPI
2. Read the message line and the result area
cases.expected: The message line shows "Enter an authorization id and press ENTER." The Card Num, Acct ID, Amount, Merchant, Req TS, Status and Decision fields are blank. The header date and time reflect the current system clock (for example "2026-09-28" and "10:30:00").
cases.remark: 1000-SEND-INITIAL sets ERRMSGO to WMSG guidance text; result map fields LOW-VALUES; 8500-GET-DATE-TIME FORMATTIME (date + time)

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: Auth ID is the only enterable field; all result fields stay display-only
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; transaction ORPI open on the key prompt.
cases.steps:
1. On the initial screen, move the cursor across the fields
2. Inquire Auth ID = AUTH000000000001 and observe the fields again
cases.expected: On the key prompt only the Auth ID field accepts input (cursor there); Card Num, Acct ID, Amount, Merchant, Req TS, Status and Decision cannot be typed into. After the result is shown those fields display the retrieved values but remain display-only; Auth ID can still be overtyped for the next inquiry.
cases.remark: UI §2 item-states: AUTHID UNPROT/IC/FSET (input), all others ASKIP/NORM (display-only)

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 returns to the main menu
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; transaction ORPI open (with or without a result shown).
cases.steps: 1. On the inquiry screen press PF3
cases.expected: Control passes to the main menu (OCMENU); the inquiry screen is left.
cases.remark: 2000 EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN DFHPF3 → 7000-XCTL-MENU (EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM OCMENU); CA-PGM-CONTEXT set to 0

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the screen back to the initial key prompt
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; a result for AUTH000000000001 is currently displayed.
cases.steps: 1. With a result on screen, press PF4
cases.expected: The screen is redisplayed as the initial key prompt: the message line shows "Enter an authorization id and press ENTER." and the Auth ID field and all result fields are cleared.
cases.remark: 2000 EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN DFHPF4 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL (ERASE)

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Fresh entry shows the key prompt; the transaction stays on the screen between inquiries
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; operator signed on.
cases.steps:
1. Enter the function fresh from the menu (no prior context)
2. Inquire Auth ID = AUTH000000000002 and press ENTER
3. Overtype Auth ID = AUTH000000000003 and press ENTER
cases.expected: Step 1 shows the initial key prompt. After each ENTER the transaction remains on the same inquiry screen (pseudo-conversational), showing the requested authorization and ready for the next key — it does not leave the screen.
cases.remark: 0000-MAIN: EIBCALEN=0 or CA-FIRST-ENTER → 1000-SEND-INITIAL; otherwise 2000-PROCESS-INPUT; 9000-RETURN TRANSID ORPI (pseudo-conversational)

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Inquire an existing PENDING authorization by Auth ID (main flow)
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; transaction ORPI open; record AUTH000000000001 exists with a pending status.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Auth ID = AUTH000000000001
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The authorization detail is displayed — Card Num 4111111111111111, Acct ID 00000000001, Amount 1,500.00, Merchant AMAZON.COM MARKETPLACE, Req TS 2026-09-28-10.30.00.000000, Status "PENDING", Decision AWAITING MANUAL REVIEW — and the message line shows "Pending authorization retrieved."
cases.remark: ENTER → 2100-INQUIRE → LINK OUIMSPA INQ (GU by key) → PL-OK → 4000-POPULATE-DETAIL; PA-STATUS 'P' → 'PENDING' (4100-STATUS-WORD); WS-PL-MSG

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Inquire an APPROVED authorization
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; record AUTH000000000002 exists with an approved status.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Auth ID = AUTH000000000002
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Detail for AUTH000000000002 is shown — Amount 42.50, Merchant STARBUCKS STORE 01234, Status "APPROVED", Decision AUTO APPROVED WITHIN LIMIT; message "Pending authorization retrieved."
cases.remark: PA-STATUS 'A' → 'APPROVED' (4100-STATUS-WORD) — classifier value A

cases.expected: Detail for AUTH000000000003 is shown — Amount 9,999.99, Merchant BEST BUY STORE 00077, Status "DECLINED", Decision INSUFFICIENT AVAILABLE CREDIT; message "Pending authorization retrieved."
cases.remark: PA-STATUS 'D' → 'DECLINED' (4100-STATUS-WORD) — classifier value D

cases.name: Inquire a PURGED authorization

cases.steps:

cases.expected: Detail for AUTH000000000004 is shown with Status "PURGED"; message "Pending authorization retrieved."

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: PF8 pages forward to the next authorization
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; AUTH000000000001 is currently displayed.
cases.steps: 1. With AUTH000000000001 shown, press PF8
cases.expected: The next authorization in key order, AUTH000000000002, is displayed; its id AUTH000000000002 now appears in the Auth ID field; message "Pending authorization retrieved."
cases.remark: PF8 → 2200-BROWSE-NEXT → LINK OUIMSPA NXT; OUIMSPA 2110 (GU anchor then GN); PL-OK → WS-PL-KEY → AUTHIDO

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: PF8 with a blank Auth ID returns the lowest-keyed authorization (start of list)
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; transaction ORPI open on the initial key prompt (Auth ID blank).
cases.steps:
1. Leave Auth ID blank
2. Press PF8
cases.expected: The lowest-keyed authorization AUTH000000000001 is displayed (start of the list); message "Pending authorization retrieved."
cases.remark: 2200-BROWSE-NEXT passes blank key; OUIMSPA 2100 blank key → 5400-CALL-GET-NEXT (bare GN) → lowest segment

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: PF8 when the anchor id was removed repositions to the next higher id
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; the screen shows Auth ID AUTH000000000002, but that record was removed from OPAUDB by another task *(needs real data)*.
cases.steps: 1. With AUTH000000000002 on screen (now absent in the database), press PF8
cases.expected: The browse repositions past the missing id and displays the first higher authorization AUTH000000000003; message "Pending authorization retrieved."
cases.remark: OUIMSPA 2110-POSITION-THEN-NEXT: anchor GU → 'GE' → re-GU with ODLI-OP-GT (key >) → first higher segment

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Refine the key and inquire again over a shown result
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; AUTH000000000001 is currently displayed.
cases.steps:
1. With AUTH000000000001 shown, overtype Auth ID = AUTH000000000003
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The previous detail is replaced by the AUTH000000000003 authorization (Amount 9,999.99, Status "DECLINED"); message "Pending authorization retrieved."
cases.remark: UI §1.2 function 3 (refine key and inquire again); 2100-INQUIRE re-run

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Amount is displayed with thousands separators and two decimals
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; AUTH000000000001 has amount 1500.00.
cases.steps:
1. Inquire Auth ID = AUTH000000000001 (ENTER)
2. Read the Amount field
cases.expected: The stored amount 1500.00 is displayed formatted as "1,500.00" — grouped with a thousands separator and shown with two decimal places.
cases.remark: 4000: MOVE PA-AMOUNT (S9(9)V99) TO WS-ED-AMT (edit mask -,---,---,--9.99) TO PAAMTO

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: An unrecognized status code is displayed as UNKNOWN
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; AUTH000000000005 has a status byte other than P, A, D or X *(needs real data)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Auth ID = AUTH000000000005
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The detail is shown with Status "UNKNOWN" (the fallback for any status code other than P, A, D or X); message "Pending authorization retrieved."
cases.remark: 4100-STATUS-WORD EVALUATE PA-STATUS WHEN OTHER → 'UNKNOWN' — classifier fallback

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Inquiry is read-only and idempotent
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; AUTH000000000001 exists.
cases.steps:
1. Inquire Auth ID = AUTH000000000001 (ENTER)
2. Inquire the same Auth ID = AUTH000000000001 again (ENTER)
cases.expected: Both inquiries return identical detail; the authorization record in OPAUDB is unchanged — no row is created, updated or deleted by the inquiry (the screen only reads).
cases.remark: design §5 read-only; OUIMSPA INQ path issues GU only; no ISRT/REPL/DLET reachable from this screen

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: Inquiry hands the request to the DL/I access module and returns to the menu on PF3
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; AUTH000000000001 exists.
cases.steps:
1. Inquire Auth ID = AUTH000000000001 (ENTER)
2. Press PF3
cases.expected: On ENTER the request (function INQ plus the Auth ID key) is passed to the pending-authorization access module OUIMSPA through the shared communication area, and the returned segment is painted on the screen with "Pending authorization retrieved." On PF3 control is handed to the main menu (OCMENU).
cases.remark: 3000-CALL-SUB EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM OUIMSPA COMMAREA ORION-COMMAREA (CA-WORK-AREA = WS-PAU-LINK: WS-PL-FUNC INQ, WS-PL-KEY); 7000 XCTL OCMENU

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Blank Auth ID on ENTER is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; transaction ORPI open on the key prompt.
cases.steps:
1. Leave Auth ID blank
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The inquiry is not sent to the database; the message line shows "Please enter all required fields." and the cursor stays for re-entry.
cases.remark: 2100-INQUIRE: IF AUTHIDI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES → WS-MSG-REQUIRED (WMSG) → 8100-SEND-DATAONLY; no LINK issued

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Auth ID not on file returns a not-found message
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; no record for AUTH000000000099.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Auth ID = AUTH000000000099 (not present in OPAUDB)
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: No detail is shown; the message line shows "No pending authorization for that id."
cases.remark: OUIMSPA 2000 GU → LK-PCB-STATUS 'GE' → 6100-NOT-FOUND (WS-PL-STATUS GE, WS-PL-MSG); OCPAUIN shows CA-ERR-MSG

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unsupported function key is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; transaction ORPI open.
cases.steps: 1. Press an unsupported key, for example PF12
cases.expected: The screen is redisplayed and the message line shows "Invalid key pressed. Please try again."; only ENTER, PF3, PF4 and PF8 are accepted.
cases.remark: 2000 EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN OTHER → 1000-SEND-INITIAL + WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY (WMSG) → 8100-SEND-DATAONLY

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unexpected database status is reported
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; the pending-authorization database returns an unexpected status on the read *(needs real data — force a database fault, e.g. database unavailable)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Auth ID = AUTH000000000001
2. Press ENTER while the database returns an unexpected status
cases.data: Auth ID = AUTH000000000001; forced database fault
cases.expected: No detail is shown; the message line shows a database error text of the form "DL/I error status=xx func=GU  ", where xx is the two-character status returned.
cases.remark: OUIMSPA 2000 EVALUATE WS-DLI-STATUS WHEN OTHER → 6900-DLI-ERROR (STRING 'DL/I error status=' … ' func=' …) + DISPLAY to system log; OCPAUIN shows CA-ERR-MSG; env-fault class (also reachable on the PF8/GN path)

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Failure to reach the access module is reported
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; the DL/I access module OUIMSPA is unavailable *(needs real data — force a link failure)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Auth ID = AUTH000000000001
2. Press ENTER while module OUIMSPA cannot be linked
cases.expected: No detail is shown; the message line shows "Unable to link to IMS module OUIMSPA."
cases.remark: 3000-CALL-SUB: IF WS-RESP-CD NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL) → CA-ERR-MSG 'Unable to link to IMS module OUIMSPA.', WS-PL-STATUS 'ER'

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Auth ID at maximum length (16 characters) is accepted and matched
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; a record whose key uses all 16 characters, AUTH000000000006.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Auth ID = AUTH000000000006 (16 characters, the field maximum)
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The full 16-character key is accepted without truncation and the AUTH000000000006 authorization is displayed; message "Pending authorization retrieved."
cases.remark: AUTHID picin 16; PA-AUTH-ID PIC X(16) segment key

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A single-character Auth ID is accepted as the lookup key
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; no record keyed "1".
cases.steps:
1. Enter Auth ID = 1 (one character)
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The one-character entry is accepted (right-padded to the 16-character key) and used to look up; since no such authorization exists, the message line shows "No pending authorization for that id."
cases.remark: AUTHID has no format restriction; short key padded to X(16); GU 'GE' → 6100-NOT-FOUND

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Zero amount is displayed as 0.00
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; AUTH000000000007 has amount 0.00.
cases.steps:
1. Inquire Auth ID = AUTH000000000007 (ENTER)
2. Read the Amount field
cases.expected: The Amount field shows "0.00" (zero rendered with two decimal places and no leading digits).
cases.remark: PA-AMOUNT 0 through edit mask -,---,---,--9.99

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Maximum amount displays fully with separators
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; AUTH000000000006 has amount 999999999.99 (the field maximum).
cases.steps:
1. Inquire Auth ID = AUTH000000000006 (ENTER)
2. Read the Amount field
cases.expected: The Amount field shows the maximum "999,999,999.99" in full, grouped with thousands separators and two decimals, without overflow.
cases.remark: PA-AMOUNT max S9(9)V99 through mask -,---,---,--9.99 (13-digit edited field)

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A negative amount displays with a leading minus
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; AUTH000000000008 has amount -500.00 (a reversal).
cases.steps:
1. Inquire Auth ID = AUTH000000000008 (ENTER)
2. Read the Amount field
cases.expected: The Amount field shows "-500.00" — the sign position of the edit mask renders the leading minus for a negative amount.
cases.remark: PA-AMOUNT S9(9)V99 signed; floating '-' sign of mask -,---,---,--9.99

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Full-width Merchant and Req TS display without truncation
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; AUTH000000000006 has a 50-character Merchant and a 26-character Req TS.
cases.steps:
1. Inquire Auth ID = AUTH000000000006 (ENTER)
2. Read the Merchant and Req TS fields
cases.expected: The Merchant field shows the full 50-character name without truncation and the Req TS field shows the full 26-character timestamp "2026-09-28-10.35.00.000000", each filling its field width.
cases.remark: PAMERCH 50 cols / PA-MERCHANT X(50); PAREQTS 26 cols / PA-REQUEST-TS X(26)

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Paging past the last authorization reports end of list
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded in OPAUDB; AUTH000000000008 (the highest key) is currently displayed.
cases.steps: 1. With the highest-keyed authorization AUTH000000000008 shown, press PF8
cases.expected: No further authorization is shown; the message line shows "End of pending authorization list." and the last record stays displayed.
cases.remark: OUIMSPA 2100 GN → 'GB'/'GE' → 6200-END-OF-LIST (WS-PL-STATUS 'GB', WS-PL-MSG)
